title: 12，卧槽，飞人？！
slug: 人在俄乌当佣兵杀敌就能爆属性
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

也可能是无人机丢下来的小炸弹。

也可能是改装过的榴弹。

但不管它到底叫什么，在这个距离，在这个环境里，对沈飞来说都只有一个意思。

要炸了！

“趴下！！！”

沈飞来不及找那玩意儿落到了哪里，更来不及提醒第二遍。

他的身体猛地向射击坑内侧一缩，整个人死死贴住坑壁和胸墙形成的夹角，把头压到最低，嘴巴下意识张开。

这是训练营里老兵骂出来的动作，因为爆炸时闭着嘴硬扛，耳膜和内脏更容易遭殃。

能不能保命另说，至少比傻站着强！

穆萨反应慢了半拍，刚抬头想问发生了什么，沈飞已经一把按住他的后颈，把他往泥里压。

下一秒。

爆炸在主壕沟里炸开。

火光从侧后方闪了一下，紧接着就是一股热浪和不知道什么东西的残片，从射击坑后方卷了过来。

沈飞只觉得后背像被人狠狠踹了一脚，整个人差点被震得撞上胸墙。

刚刚才稍微恢复一点的听觉，再次被炸成了一片尖锐的鸣响。

泥土劈头盖脸砸下来。

沙袋里的土被震得往外喷。

观察缝前面的火光一闪即灭，整个世界又重新变成黑暗。

沈飞趴在泥里，几秒钟都没有动，能感觉到自己的心脏在狂跳。

像是要把肋骨砸开。

身边的穆萨也趴着没动，只剩下粗重的喘息声。

两人之所以没被炸碎，完全是因为射击坑和主壕沟之间有一个夹角。

爆炸的破片大多沿着主壕沟方向扫了过去，被拐角的沙袋和木板挡掉了一部分。

如果那东西直接落进射击坑，或者滚到他们脚下，现在两个人大概率已经变成了需要别人用铲子收拾的东西。

就在这时，阵地左侧的机枪突然开火了。

哒哒哒哒哒————

一串火舌从壕沟另一侧喷了出去，紧接着，夜空里划出几道红亮的线。

这是用来校准的曳光弹，通常五发里夹着一发。

开枪了？

沈飞脑子里嗡嗡作响。

他们看到敌人了？

他不知道。

也听不清维克多有没有下命令。

但机枪既然开火，就说明敌人不是已经摸到了近处，就是机枪手被刚才那枚爆炸物吓疯了。

这两种情况都不是什么好消息。

沈飞咬着牙，强忍着脑袋里那股尖锐的耳鸣，把AK-74M重新架到射击口后方。

他什么都看不清，前方依旧是黑的。

只有机枪曳光弹划过时，才能勉强照出几棵断树，几个弹坑，以及地面上翻卷的烟雾。

没有敌人！

可这个时候，沈飞已经顾不上那么多了。

他把枪口压向机枪扫射的大致方向，扣动扳机。

哒哒哒！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Or it could be a small bomb dropped by a drone.

It could also be a modified grenade.

But no matter what it is called, at this distance and in this environment, it has only one meaning to Shen Fei.

It's going to explode!

"Get down!!!"

Shen Fei didn't have time to find where the thing had fallen, nor did he have time to remind him a second time.

His body suddenly shrank toward the inside of the shooting pit, and his whole body clung to the angle formed by the pit wall and the parapet. He lowered his head to the lowest position and opened his mouth subconsciously.

This is a move scolded by veterans in the training camp, because if you hold it with your mouth closed during an explosion, your eardrums and internal organs are more likely to suffer.

Whether he can save his life or not is another matter, but at least it is better than standing there stupidly!

Musa was a little slow to react. Just as he raised his head to ask what happened, Shen Fei had already held the back of his neck and pushed him into the mud.

The next second.

The explosion exploded in the main trench.

The fire flashed from the side and behind, followed by a wave of heat and the debris of unknown objects, rolling over from behind the shooting pit.

Shen Fei felt as if someone had kicked him hard on his back, and he was almost hit by the shock.

The hearing that had just recovered a little was once again exploded into a sharp sound.

Mud rained down on his face.

The soil in the sandbags was shaken and sprayed out.

The fire in front of the observation slit extinguished in a flash, and the whole world turned into darkness again.

Shen Fei lay in the mud and didn't move for a few seconds. He could feel his heart beating wildly.

Like cracking the ribs open.

Musa next to him also lay motionless, leaving only the sound of heavy breathing.

The reason why the two men were not blown to pieces was entirely because there was an angle between the shooting pit and the main trench.

Most of the fragments of the explosion swept along the direction of the main trench, and were partially blocked by sandbags and wooden boards at the corners.

If that thing fell directly into the shooting pit, or rolled to their feet, the two of them would most likely have become something that someone else would need to clean up with a shovel.

At this moment, the machine gun on the left side of the position suddenly opened fire.

Da da da da da————

A string of flames spurted out from the other side of the trench, and then several bright red lines were drawn in the night sky.

This is a tracer bullet used for calibration, usually one in five rounds.

Shot?

Shen Fei's mind was buzzing.

Did they see the enemy?

He doesn't know.

It was also unclear whether Victor gave any orders.

But since the machine gun fired, it meant that either the enemy was close, or the machine gunner was frightened crazy by the explosive just now.

Neither situation is good news.

Shen Fei gritted his teeth, suppressed the sharp tinnitus in his head, and put the AK-74M behind the shooting port again.

He couldn't see anything clearly, the front was still dark.

Only the machine gun tracer bullets could barely illuminate a few broken trees, a few craters, and the smoke rolling on the ground.

No enemies!

But at this time, Shen Fei didn't care so much anymore.

He pressed the muzzle of the gun in the general direction of the machine gun fire and pulled the trigger.

Ta-ta-ta!
